item.title: Major Bureaucratic Reshuffle: Centre Transfers 31 IAS, 18 IPS Officers of AGMUT Cadre
item.description: The central government has ordered the transfer of 31 IAS and 18 IPS officers of the AGMUT cadre with immediate effect. Issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs, the reshuffle includes major postings involving Delhi, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Arunachal Pradesh, Goa and other Union Territories.

item.title: US–Venezuela Standoff: Caracas claims 40 killed in alleged US strike; Full update
item.description: Venezuela alleges 40 deaths after an alleged US military operation, citing civilian and military casualties, while President Donald Trump denies US losses and calls the mission precise and successful. Reports claim Maduro’s detention and plans for temporary administration.

item.title: US-India trade tensions rise as Trump warns of new tariffs over Russian crude
item.description: resident Donald Trump warned of new tariffs on Indian goods if concerns over India’s Russian oil purchases persist. Despite resumed talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, trade negotiations remain strained. India defends energy security while sanctions bite, pushing imports lower.

item.title: Indian markets open volatile; Sensex slips 50 points, Nifty flat
item.description: Indian equity markets opened volatile on Monday with the Sensex slipping around 50 points and the Nifty trading nearly flat. Investors are tracking PMI data, global cues and foreign investor activity amid a data-heavy week and early earnings season.

item.title: Bengaluru: Stone pelting disrupts chariot procession; Police register FIR
item.description: A complaint was received alleging that miscreants threw stones at the chariot during the procession. According to the news agency, two children sustained head injuries in the incident.

item.title: Deepika Padukone turns 40, celebrates with fans before flying to New York
item.description: Deepika Padukone celebrated her 40th birthday by cutting a cake with fans in Mumbai before flying to New York with Ranveer Singh. The gratitude event went viral as fans poured love on the actor. With upcoming film King alongside Shah Rukh Khan, the year looks big.

item.title: Magh Mela 2026: Can’t visit Prayagraj? Follow this home ritual for Ganga Snan
item.description: Magh Mela 2026 is underway in Prayagraj from January 3 to February 15. If devotees cannot travel, they can perform a sacred Ganga Snan at home by adding Ganga Jal to water and following proper rituals. The practice is believed to grant similar spiritual benefits.

item.title: India’s ‘Neighbourhood First’ policy faces its sternest test in 2026
item.description: The instability in these three countries could have a direct impact not only within their borders but also on India's security, diplomacy, and regional role. In this context, India's 'Neighbourhood First' policy is about to face its most challenging test yet.

item.title: Delhi Riots Case: SC rejects Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam bail; Grants to others
item.description: The Supreme Court allowed bail for Gulfisha Fatima, Meeran Haider, Shifa Ur Rehman, Mohd. Saleem Khan, and Shadab Ahmad while rejecting bail pleas of Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam in the Delhi riots conspiracy case.

item.title: Rajasthan Horror: Three killed, 10 injured as bus overturns on highway
item.description: The Ahore Station House Officer (SHO) Karan Singh said that the accident occurred at around 10 pm when the bus lost control and overturned on the highway.
